variants.value: collar across<=4px, along<=2px (strike-aligned); fixed-count H19-5 refill

mechanism_card.hypothesis: R0's isotropic 2 px collar removes across-strike flank mass and along-strike continuation with equal force. Widening the collar to 4 px across strike only, at fixed dot count, should raise DTI if near-catalogue flank dots are predominantly false mass while along-strike continuations are predominantly real unmapped geometry.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Known catalogue pixels are masked pixel-exactly while new-fault truth can sit within 300 m of a known trace, so the collar trades false-positive mass against adjacent true credit. The parent's 2 px collar is direction-free: it removes flank mass and along-strike continuation alike. On a 400 m-spacing survey the positional error that matters is cross-strike, and along-strike continuation of a mapped trace is real (unmapped geometry of existing systems is explicitly scored). This family therefore widens the collar only across strike, holding the parent's 2 px radius along strike, at fixed dot count.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: A dot a few pixels across strike from a mapped trace may be a real parallel strand, a step-over, or the surface expression of a steeply dipping strand whose surface trace is offset from the mapped line; the refill pixels are H19-5 thinning-order picks, which are lithologic contacts or drainage lineaments as often as faults.
mechanism_card.predicted_live_change: +0.003 DTI (MODEL; plausible -0.010 to +0.010; not a score)
mechanism_card.prediction_decomposition: collar term +0.004 to +0.006 (2632 dots at median 2.8 px across strike removed), refill dilution -0.001 to -0.003 (2632 dots added a median 1.0 px from a retained dot), net +0.003
mechanism_card.refill_confound: 99.5% of the 2632 refill dots sit within 3 px of a retained dot (median 1.00 px), so the fixed-count refill adds mostly penalty, little fresh kernel credit. The removed dots are non-local replacements (median displaced 888 px). Both terms are inherited from the parent lineage's refill policy, not from the collar geometry under test.
mechanism_card.falsifier: A paired, same-week live receipt against R0 with delta <= -0.010 falsifies the across-strike-only collar at this dose; any |delta| < 0.010 is no evidence under the session rule. A monotone decline across A = 4, 5, 6 would additionally reject the dose-response implied by the mechanism.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: Read the removed set as two populations: flank dots at 2-3 px across strike from mapped traces (the predicted false mass) and along-strike continuations beyond mapped tips (which this edit deliberately keeps). Check whether the kept continuations look like real projections of the mapped geometry or like an artefact of the structure-tensor window.
mechanism_card.information_value: Separates 'wider collar pays' from 'along-strike collateral costs' only together with the isotropic rungs; on its own it says whether the across-strike-only collar moves the live score at all.

variants.value: tag=r2p12p5pct; shift 12.5% R0 mass (4707 dots) range_front->piedmont; fixed count 37654; added d_cat>=3px

mechanism_card.hypothesis: Shifting 12.5% of R0 mass (4,707 dots) out of high-relief Range-front/horst interiors (T3) into Piedmont/bajada aprons (T2) trims false-positive erosional bedrock ridges while densifying H19-5 coverage across range-bounding synthetic splays, relay ramps, and step-over zones without placing mass onto flat, thickly buried playa floors.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Landform relief terciles are computed from `det_elev` (0.85 percentile weight) and 3 km Gaussian-smoothed `det_elev_slope` (0.15 percentile weight). R0 allocates 37.95% of dots to T3 vs 29.19% of known USGS/INGENIOUS faults because bare bedrock topography excites ridge detectors. Greedily dropping the 4,707 lowest-exclusive-credit R0 dots in T3 and greedily adding the 4,707 highest-marginal-credit H19-5 ridge pixels in T2 (all with d_cat >= 3.0 px) holds count fixed at 37,654 while tightening kernel coverage along piedmont fault corridors where 400 m GeoDAWN flight-line spacing leaves ~150-300 m lateral position uncertainty.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: Coalescing alluvial-fan incised channels, terrace risers, Lake Lahontan highstand shorelines, and piedmont road/pipeline magnetic anomalies can mimic piedmont fault lineaments in H19-5.

mechanism_card.falsifier: A paired live receipt against R0 with Δ <= -0.010 DTI falsifies piedmont enrichment at fixed count (indicating undisclosed test labels favor range/bedrock traces or lose more from T3 submodular thinning than T2 infill gains). Any |Δ| < 0.010 is no evidence.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: All 37,654 dots remain on the corroborated H19-5 geophysical/topographic ridge network; no external lidar or non-lineage field was substituted. Review removed donor segments against bedrock lithologic contacts and added recipient segments against mapped fans/playas.

variants.value: tag=strain10; 5km blocks; prior=geodetic strain-rate invariant band4 (label-agnostic); move 10% R0 mass (3765 dots) low->high strain; 50% pool; fixed count 37654; added d_cat>=3px

mechanism_card.hypothesis: New (unmapped) faults preferentially nucleate and slip where the present-day crust is actively deforming. Moving 10% of R0's fixed mass budget OUT of the lowest-strain-rate 5 km blocks INTO the highest-strain-rate blocks raises 300 m-kernel coverage of the actively deforming ground most likely to host undiscovered traces, at unchanged total mass penalty.
mechanism_card.mechanism: The geodetic second invariant (band 4) is a direct, label-agnostic measure of strain-rate magnitude from GPS/InSAR. R0's block density is nearly uncorrelated with it (rank r~+0.11) and it is relief-neutral (r~-0.07 to the detrended-elevation tercile index), so this move is orthogonal to both the physiographic RELIEF axis and the catalogue-density CONCENTRATION built in a sibling session. Within complementary top/bottom-half strain pools we greedily drop the lowest-exclusive-credit R0 dots in low-strain blocks and add the highest-marginal-credit off-catalogue H19-5 ridge pixels (all d_cat>=3.0 px) in high-strain blocks, holding count at 37,654. Block-density CV at 15 km rises 0.510->~0.57, still inside the owner-reported 'best files 0.51-0.59' band; the density-strain rank correlation rises +0.11->+0.26.
mechanism_card.non_fault_confounder: Strain-rate model artefacts where GPS/InSAR station spacing is sparse; anthropogenic or hydrologic/volcanic transients (groundwater withdrawal, geothermal fluid extraction, magma inflation) that raise apparent strain without brittle upper-crustal faulting; and strain gradients that localise on ductile shear or magmatic systems rather than seismogenic faults.
mechanism_card.predicted_live_change: +0.004 DTI (MODEL; plausible interval -0.010 to +0.015; not a score)
mechanism_card.falsifier: A paired live receipt vs R0 with delta <= -0.010 DTI falsifies strain-guided concentration at this dose. If the matched-dose sign control `strainAway10` (similar CV, opposite strain alignment) scores >= strain10, the strain prior itself is falsified. Any |delta|<0.010 is no evidence.
mechanism_card.structural_geologist_note: All 37,654 dots remain on the corroborated H19-5 ridge network; the ranking prior is the competition-supplied geodetic strain-rate invariant, NOT a catalogue-derived field, so this is a physical-deformation test rather than a label-geography test. Review added high-strain segments against GPS/InSAR station density and known geothermal/subsidence/volcanic centres, and removed low-strain segments against mapped aseismic bedrock faults.
